owner_approval.evidence: Owner asked in chat: rerun clustering with log + winsorize, rank standardization, k=3-8 sweep with a minimum cluster size, compare k-means/GMM, write a report, and wait for approval before swapping the served model.

C.source: December A + same fiscal year B

transforms.T0: baseline as served: robust scaling (A) / z-score (B, B2) per snapshot
transforms.T1: log1p(liquidity_21), winsorize every feature at p1/p99 within the snapshot, z-score
transforms.T2: rank within the snapshot -> normal scores (rankit), ties averaged

reference_space: T1 (log + winsor + z-score) for silhouette/Davies-Bouldin, so transforms are compared in one geometry
selection_rule: Among admissible configs: highest median reference-space silhouette; ties within 0.01 -> smaller k, then T1 before T2, kmeans before gmm. Returns, Sharpe or any portfolio metric are never used.
promotion: No automatic promotion; served terminal.sqlite unchanged until owner approval.
